summary: ```markdown # GPU Rendering on macOS | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe here, and I have a great update to share with you for rendering, especially with maps. This feature was introduced in our 2025.0 version. So let's jump on in and have some fun while we learn! ## Accessing Render Settings in Clo Here, I actually have Clo open on a map. I'm going to go to my top toolbar here and select **Render**. This is where the fun begins! ## Image and Render Settings In this dropdown for the engine, I can select **GPU**. I can then choose if I want to use **CPU support**, load **GPU priority**, and all of that stuff if I want. ## Rendering with GPU Now, the option is GPU. If you want to use GPU rendering and not just CPU for your maps, you can hit **Stop** and then **Play**, and Clo will render it out for you. ## Performance Demonstration I mean, look at that speed! So quick. You can have a beautiful rendered image all for you, just like this one. Pretty cool, right? ## Conclusion Thank you so much for watching! If you have any questions, use that comment section down below. Don't forget to like and subscribe. Check out our YouTube channel for lots of great videos to watch, and keep having fun in Clo! ```
